layer1.label: Political Power & Regime
layer1.definition: Events that alter who holds power, how that power is structured, and the legitimacy of the state's governing authority.

layer2.label: Electoral Politics
layer2.definition: Competitive elections, voting processes, party formation, disputed results

layer2.label: Government Formation
layer2.definition: Cabinet formation, leadership succession, institutional appointments

layer2.label: Constitutional Change
layer2.definition: Constitutional rewrites, referenda, devolution, federalism reforms

layer2.label: Democratic Transition
layer2.definition: Transitions to/from democracy, post-authoritarian openings, decolonization

layer2.label: Executive Power Consolidation
layer2.definition: Leaders extending personal authority, term limit removals, judiciary capture

layer2.label: Military Coup
layer2.definition: Coups, junta rule, military governments, coup attempts

layer2.label: Transitional Justice
layer2.definition: Truth commissions, war crimes trials, reparations, post-atrocity accountability

layer2.label: Peacekeeping & Peace Process
layer2.definition: Formal peace negotiations, disarmament processes, UN peace missions

layer1.label: Conflict & Political Violence
layer1.definition: Events involving organized armed force — from interstate wars and insurgencies to terrorism and state-sanctioned political killing.

layer2.label: Interstate War
layer2.definition: Declared or undeclared armed conflict between sovereign states

layer2.label: Civil War & Insurgency
layer2.definition: Internal armed conflict, guerrilla warfare, rebel movements

layer2.label: Terrorism & Extremism
layer2.definition: Non-state political violence targeting civilians, extremist attacks

layer2.label: Foreign Military Intervention
layer2.definition: External states deploying military force into another country's territory

layer2.label: Ethnic & Communal Violence
layer2.definition: Intercommunal violence, sectarian conflict, gang warfare, organized crime violence

layer2.label: Political Violence
layer2.definition: Assassinations, death squads, targeted killings of political figures

layer1.label: State Authority & Governance
layer1.definition: Events concerning how the state exercises authority over its citizens — including repression, corruption, surveillance, media control, and failures of rule of law.

layer2.label: Political Repression
layer2.definition: State suppression of opposition, political prisoners, censorship, forced disappearances

layer2.label: Political Corruption
layer2.definition: Bribery, kleptocracy, state capture, cartel infiltration of government

layer2.label: Human Rights Violations
layer2.definition: Systemic abuses — torture, extrajudicial killings, mass atrocities

layer2.label: Human Rights Reform
layer2.definition: Landmark rights expansions — new constitutional protections, minority rights, gender rights

layer2.label: Military Policy & Security Reform
layer2.definition: Defense doctrine changes, military professionalization, nuclear programs, security sector reform

layer1.label: Economic & Financial Stress
layer1.definition: Events with primary economic causation or consequence — crises, reforms, trade shifts, and financial shocks that reshape a country's material conditions and fiscal position.

layer2.label: Currency & Banking Crisis
layer2.definition: Currency devaluations, banking system failures, capital flight

layer2.label: Economic Recession & Austerity
layer2.definition: GDP contractions, sovereign debt crises, IMF programs, austerity packages

layer2.label: Fiscal & Monetary Policy
layer2.definition: Budget policy changes, central bank decisions, tax reforms, debt restructuring

layer2.label: Economic Liberalization
layer2.definition: Market opening, privatization, Washington Consensus-style reforms

layer2.label: Economic Nationalization
layer2.definition: State takeovers of industry, resource nationalism, expropriation

layer2.label: Economic Recovery & Growth
layer2.definition: Post-crisis rebounds, growth milestones, economic miracles

layer2.label: Trade & Investment
layer2.definition: Trade agreements, trade disputes, FDI, industrial policy, sanctions

layer2.label: Foreign Aid & Development
layer2.definition: Official development assistance, multilateral lending, development programs

layer1.label: Social Mobilization & Civil Society
layer1.definition: Events where citizens organize collectively — through protest, labor action, social movements, religious movements, or identity politics — to contest power or demand change.

layer2.label: Mass Protest
layer2.definition: Large-scale street demonstrations, civic strikes, popular uprisings

layer2.label: Labor Action
layer2.definition: Strikes, trade union activity, labor rights movements

layer2.label: Social Policy Reform
layer2.definition: Changes to welfare systems, education, housing, healthcare policy

layer2.label: Poverty & Inequality
layer2.definition: Documented poverty crises, inequality deteriorations, social exclusion events

layer2.label: Religious & Social Movements
layer2.definition: Religious revivals, liberation theology, faith-based political organizing

layer2.label: Migration & Refugees
layer2.definition: Forced displacement, refugee crises, emigration waves, diaspora formation

layer1.label: Diplomatic & Geopolitical Relations
layer1.definition: Events governing how countries relate to each other and to multilateral institutions — treaties, ruptures, integration, sanctions, and territorial disputes.

layer2.label: Bilateral Treaties
layer2.definition: State-to-state agreements — diplomatic normalization, security pacts, bilateral cooperation

layer2.label: Multilateral Agreements
layer2.definition: UN resolutions, international conventions, multilateral security arrangements

layer2.label: Diplomatic Rupture
layer2.definition: Embassy closures, expulsions, severing of diplomatic relations — includes sanctions (dual-labeled with D7)

layer2.label: Territorial Disputes
layer2.definition: Border conflicts, sovereignty contests, maritime claims

layer2.label: Regional Integration
layer2.definition: Accession to regional blocs, common market membership, supra-national governance

layer1.label: Humanitarian & Environmental Crisis
layer1.definition: Events where large populations face acute threats to survival — from natural disasters to famines to epidemics.

layer2.label: Natural Disaster
layer2.definition: Earthquakes, floods, cyclones, volcanic eruptions, wildfires — acute physical events

layer2.label: Drought & Famine
layer2.definition: Prolonged water scarcity, crop failure, mass hunger, food insecurity crises

layer2.label: Epidemic & Pandemic
layer2.definition: Infectious disease outbreaks and public health crises with mass casualties

layer2.label: Humanitarian Crisis
layer2.definition: Multi-cause human suffering emergencies — post-conflict, displacement, siege

layer2.label: Water & Resource Crisis
layer2.definition: Water system failures, scarcity conflicts, access disputes not driven by conflict actors

layer1.label: Structural & Development Context
layer1.definition: Events that shape a country's long-run structural trajectory — energy systems, environmental policy, digital transformation, resource governance, infrastructure.

layer2.label: Energy Policy & Resources
layer2.definition: Hydrocarbon policy, energy transitions, nationalization of energy, oil discoveries

layer2.label: Environmental Policy
layer2.definition: Deforestation governance, conservation policy, environmental agreements

layer2.label: Climate Agreements
layer2.definition: International climate commitments, NDCs, multilateral climate action

layer2.label: Resource Conflict
layer2.definition: Mining, water, land conflicts driven by resource extraction or scarcity

layer2.label: Infrastructure & Urban Development
layer2.definition: Major infrastructure projects, urban development waves, transport networks

layer2.label: Education & Knowledge
layer2.definition: Education reforms, research milestones, intellectual movements

layer2.label: Digital & Technology
layer2.definition: Cyber policy, technology breakthroughs, cyberattacks, digital governance

layer2.label: Cultural & Heritage
layer2.definition: National identity events, cultural milestones, sports, heritage

layer2.label: Agricultural Policy
layer2.definition: Agrarian reform, land redistribution, agricultural development policy
